newsitem.title: CHINA: China says new weather satellite sending pictures.
newsitem.headline: China says new weather satellite sending pictures.

text.p: China's new Fengyun-2 meteorological satellite is stable and has transmitted many clear photographs of the earth since its launch last month, the Xinhua news agency said.
Control of the weather satellite, which was successfully fired into orbit on June 10, would soon be turned over to the State Meteorological Administration, the agency said in an overnight report.
Pictures transmitted by the satellite from its station 35,800 km above earth had been used in weather forecasts broadcast by Chinese state television, it said.
It gave no other details of the orbiter's condition.
The successful launch of the Fengyun-2 was a welcome boost to China's satellite business, which had been hit by a string of high-profile failures in 1995 and 1996.
